clientRules.query: trim; Array.from per code point lowercase only if JS UTF16 length unchanged; matchingMode IGNORE_CASE
clientRules.inputToScorer: file_name only; path and backend score are not ranking inputs
clientRules.caseContribution: new noninitial fragment at word start and lowercase pattern: -10; else exact uppercase pattern: +50; else exact first char with caller startMatch flag: +150; else exact char at word start:+1; else case mismatch at word start or uppercase-match carry:-1; else0. Actual wrapper passes startMatch=false and lowercases ordinary query, disabling the +150 and ordinary ASCII +50 branches.
tieBreak: original case-sensitive JS relational label ascending, not locale/natural order
clientRules.prefixPatterns: ordinary query=*query; path query separators -> *NUL*; candidate separators -> NUL; if whole path fails, nonempty final path component matcher has no leading wildcard
clientRules.pathWeight: No path/recent/root multiplier in QXc; backend order only survives identical score and identical label.
clientRules.unicode: Word starts use ASCII /[a-z0-9]/i plus Unicode upper/lower comparison; score length UTF16. No pinyin/accent normalization visible in this client matcher.
clientRules.longPatternFallback: if compiledPattern.length>100, remove * and use case-insensitive substring (leading*) or prefix (no leading*); spaces remain literal in this fallback.
